watch.summary: The streamer completely whiffs an easy hit in Rocket League and screams in loud disbelief at his own mistake.

beats.what: Streamer lines up his vehicle to hit the ball in Rocket League.
He completely whiffs the ball, miscalculating his jump.
He screams in shock and disbelief at how bad the miss was.
He calmly questions how he managed to miss that.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The visual of completely missing an easy shot in Rocket League is immediately understandable to any viewer. His explosive, vocal reaction provides an entertaining energetic climax to a simple fail.
